svg.aria-label: Left panel: acoustic radius accumulated from the centre of the tabulated solar model against depth below the surface on a logarithmic axis, for the adiabatic and the isothermal sound speed, with the extension through the untabulated outer layer for two gas models and the totals the measurement requires. Right panel: the large separation implied by each case against the measured and the asymptotic values.
svg.text: Model: BS2005-AGS,OP. Measured: Huber et al. (2011). Asymptotic: × (1 + 0.026), Mosser et al. (2013). Layer: T linear from 81200 K to 5772 K.
